synopsis: Chapter 2 identifies EA25-002 as one of three Honda CMBS on-road car AEB investigations, alongside PE22-003 and EA24-002 [f1798]. It reports that EA25-002 added 295,125 Honda Insight and Passport vehicles in January 2025 [f1488]. Chapter 13 identifies it as a NHTSA engineering analysis dated January 2025 investigating false automatic braking in those vehicles, corroborating the vehicle count and adding the investigation’s subject [f10423]. These facts establish an on-road precedent but provide no investigation outcome or direct finding about heavy off-road machines [f1488, f10423, f1798].

relations.note: Both identify January 2025 coverage of 295,125 Honda Insight and Passport vehicles.
Specifies EA25-002’s agency, analysis type, date, vehicle count, and false-braking focus.
